Use when the user says "memory manager", "token check", "throttle", "relevance load", "cache clean", "memory search", "memory analyze", "dedup", "backup memory", "prompt template", "token trend", "cache reminder", "memory report", "smart load", "diagnose", "memory rank", or asks about memory/token/cache/prompt management. NOT for: general file ops, code analysis, system cleanup, document editing.
